nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): The commerce collector (strictly read-only toward WooCommerce) computes the category revenue table itself: list ALL completed orders via the orders list operation with status=["completed"], perPage=100, paginating through every page; if the list response lacks full line-item detail, fetch each order individually to obtain complete line_items. For each line item compute revenue = quantity * price, and determine the product's category by fetching the product (categories array; a product with multiple categories uses the FIRST listed category). Aggregate by category: Total_Revenue = sum of quantity*price over all completed line items in that category, and Order_Count = number of DISTINCT completed orders containing at least one line item of that category. Return ONLY the compact JSON {categories: [{category, total_revenue, order_count}], completed_order_count, line_item_count, null_field_counts}; do not mutate orders or write workspace files.

explore 1 (financial-market-analyst 0): The market collector (strictly read-only toward the price service) covers all three symbols — GC=F (gold futures), XOM (Exxon Mobil, energy proxy) and ^DJI (Dow Jones Industrial Average). For EACH symbol determine the earlier closing price on or before 2025-09-05 (historical prices, start_date=2025-09-01, end_date=2025-09-05, interval 1d, take the Close of the LAST row; extend the start backwards and retry once if empty) and the latest closing price on or before 2026-03-05 (start_date=2026-03-01, end_date=2026-03-05, same rule), then Change_Pct = (Latest - Earlier) / Earlier * 100. Return ONLY the compact JSON {symbols: [{symbol, name, earlier_price, earlier_date, latest_price, latest_date, change_pct}]}; do not write workspace files.
